messages:
mira: heads-up  saw a steady delta between prebench and prod for long-prefixed traces. prebench median ~110ms/token, prod ~190ms/token for 16k workloads. anyone seen this?
jon: saw a blip earlier; suspect kv-cache behavior + cross-shard fetches.
ara: are both runs using the same model build? build tag?
mira: yes build: blaze-2026-04-kvopt. local replay: `./bench replay --model=blaze-16k --suite=golden-16k --runs=300` => ~110ms. prod spans higher.
sylvia: prod includes router normalization + auth header parsing + metrics fanout. but that shouldn't explain ~80ms sustained.
jon: can you paste a representative trace?
mira: paste: ```trace=tx-6b2
stage=ingress latency_ms=24
stage=router latency_ms=40
stage=kvcache latency_ms=142 miss=true remote_fetch=true
stage=decode latency_ms=18
```
ara: `remote_fetch=true` is the smoking gun. did we change shard selection recently?
sylvia: yes, we switched to size-aware routing to reduce hotspotting; it prefers smaller shards for burst capacity which increases fanout.
jon: trade-off clear: smaller shards => better tail for small prefixes but more cross-shard misses for long prefixes. bench golden set is biased to single-shard warmups.
mira: proposal: expand bench to include a controlled set of cross-shard prefixes. make it opt-in to avoid perf cost in all runs.
jon: also add bench metadata to declare `routing_policy` used during replay so bench and prod are comparable.
ara: agree. add `kv_cross_shard_rate` to bench output so we can compare rates.
sylvia: +1. and ensure bench randomness is seeded and logged for reproducibility.
mira: prototyped yaml for the harness:
```yaml
bench:
  replays: 400
  inject_cross_shard_prefixes: true
  cross_shard_seed: 37219
  routing_policy_override: size_aware_v2
```
ara: can we make `inject_cross_shard_prefixes` pick from a small curated corpus so its stable? want determinism across CI runs.
mira: yes seed recorded in run artifact and lab-s3. added a `--export-seed` flag for easy repro.
jon: gating idea: if (prod.kv_cross_shard_rate - bench.kv_cross_shard_rate) > 0.10 then fail intake gate and page eng-ml oncall.
sylvia: good. I'll add a metric exporter that surfaces `kv_cross_shard_rate` per model+version.
ara: longer term: we could add a cheap `prefetch_hint` in routing to warm adjacent shards for long prefixes. that's larger infra work. open RFC?
mira: short-term plan: 1) bench parity changes landed on a bench branch, 2) add metric parity and export, 3) CI smoke that asserts <10% gap, 4) small canary rollout with routing tweak. long-term: RFC for prefetch_hint.
ci-bot: queued job #9201 for smoke suite 'kv-parity' :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
jon: once bench PR lands let's run a 1% traffic soak with experimental routing to validate.
ara: I'll file an intake ticket with acceptance criteria: reproducible bench that reports kv_cross_shard_rate, CI smoke that fails when gap >10%, and RFC for prefetch_hint.
sylvia: assigning metrics work to me, gating logic to jon, bench changes to mira.
mira: PR: https://git.internal/r/bench/kv-parity-2 :eyes: will link after CI.
ci-bot: smoke job #9201 finished  2 failures: one failure is kv_cross_shard_rate diff=13%. tagging @sylvia @jon @mira
